source: TSMC 3Q26 earnings release and management report, 15 Oct 2026
title: From revenue to net profit, step by step
notes: US$ at NT$31.98, the rate implied by reported revenue of US$46.72B. Operating expenses net of other operating income.

beats.caption: Start with US$46.7 billion of revenue.
A third goes on making the wafers.
Research and overheads: under eight cents in the dollar.
Interest income adds a little; tax takes about ten cents.
Net profit: US$23.9 billion, 51% of revenue.
